I'm grateful you willingly decided to fix me up rather than return me in that two year warranty time window.
What's that? The locked basement thing?
Let the bargains be bargains. You've accomplished a wonderful thing. I'm proud of you.
I'd say we won't have to see each other like this again, but knowing how things go, we'll see you in a few months.
